about: A line of text from a provider (what the agent says, what a command prints) and the record it becomes in the host's history: cleaned of terminal escapes, controls and the characters that draw nothing (U+200C and U+200D stay), and with `[agent] ` in front, once, when it begins like a record the host writes (>> , $ , > , a bracketed note). Read by a unit test of leads.rs (agent_record), by tests/test_reference_mapping.py (the reference mapping, lico_protocol/codex_mapping.py and claude_mapping.py) and by tests/test_forged_leads.py (both adapters of the built program), so the three cannot drift apart. The file holds only ASCII: the characters are \u escapes. The records are written by hand, not computed. A value is a string, or {prefix, unit, times}. `rows` are single lines that can be sent together; `long` rows are sent one at a time.
